paragraphs.text: The Society of Mishra was a secret cult of Phyrexian sympathizers within the modern-day Tolarian Academies . They are worshipers of Mishra and Gix . Their leader was Rona , Disciple of Gix, and they were thus a spiritual successor to the ancient Brotherhood of Gix .
The society helped Sheoldred in staging a new invasion of the plane. Once the Society of Mishra took control, the Academy at Lat-Nam became a haven for dark research.
In the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion , the Tolarians excised the Society of Mishra from their ranks.

Sometime shortly before the Death of Belzenlok , the Society of Mishra at the Tolarian Academy at Tolaria West was acting under the leadership of Chancellor Uthras of the School of Artifice, and based out of a network of caves on the Crescent Shore. They attempted to create a hive-mind device but were thwarted by The Traveler .
